subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed-image bytes returned through `artifacts.download` remain within the existing `operator.read` artifact contract?
rationale: The implementation can enforce provenance mechanically, but choosing whether read-scoped operators may receive Gateway-local managed-image bytes defines a permanent authorization boundary that requires Gateway-owner intent.

options.title: Keep operator.read
options.body: Treat transcript-bound managed images like other read-scoped artifacts after all session, record, URL, transcript, and coordinate bindings pass.

options.title: Require operator.admin
options.body: Raise managed-byte downloads to admin scope and update the protocol, Control UI recovery behavior, and authorization tests together before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep operator.read
recommendation.body: Treat transcript-bound managed images like other read-scoped artifacts after all session, record, URL, transcript, and coordinate bindings pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the requested reviewer and a recent contributor to the relevant Gateway media and HTTP authorization surfaces.
